newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: National Bank of Bahrain 9-month net up.
newsitem.headline: National Bank of Bahrain 9-month net up.

text.p: National Bank of Bahrain, the biggest commercial bank in the island, said on Monday its net profit for the first nine months of 1996 climbed 31 percent on the year-ago period.
A bank statement said it made 10.5 million dinars ($27.9 million), up from eight million dinars in the same nine-month period in 1995.
It attributed the rise in net profit to a 19 percent increase in net interest income, which climbed to 14.4 million dinars from 12.1 million dinars.
Total assets dropped sharply to 751.5 million dinars at end-September 1996 from 921.9 million dinars at end-September 1995.

"The lower total assets is owing to significant maturities from the bank's investment portfolio which stood at 179.1 million dinars on September 30, 1996 against 340.1 million dinars on September 30, 1995," the statement said. $1=0.38 dinars.
